integrity: Finite exact-rational checks supplement a self-contained conditional-expectation proof. The proof establishes infinite families; independent assessment is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Connected motifs and independent-edge G(n,p) only; no complete multivariate law. An earlier general mixed-moment formula may cover this specialization, so priority remains subject to independent assessment.
title: Exact component–motif covariance and induced reentrance in binomial random graphs
